approval_required: A manual ledger posting needs an approved approval bound to these lines.
currency_mismatch: All lines of a posting must be in one currency, and match the wallet's.
evidence_required: A reversal needs a stored provider event or an approved refund.
insufficient_wallet_balance: The wallet does not hold enough for this debit; top it up first.
open_exceptions_remain: The period still has open reconciliation exceptions; resolve them first.
period_already_locked: The accounting period is already locked.
period_locked: The effective date falls in a locked accounting period; post a reversal in an open one.
period_not_locked: The accounting period is not locked, so there is nothing to reopen.
unbalanced_posting: The posting's debits and credits do not balance.
unknown_ledger_account: The ledger account this posting names does not exist.
